rationale: Reference baseline and lineage root, not a candidate: the classical D^2-law with the published median rate, replaced by the prefix's own finite-difference rate as the prefix grows; no extinction and no evaporation. Same numbers as the baseline of the third-generation spec; the entries flex_methanol-wsp-v5 adds (a clock that can be wrong, the flame cameras) are switched off. Data-informed candidates of this spec are literal revisions of this release.
